title: Code fails to parse in v4.6.rc2.official [78c6632eb], works in 4.5.1
body: ### Tested versions 4.5.1: works fine v4.6.rc2.official [78c6632eb]: throws an error ### System information Godot v4.6.rc2 - macOS Tahoe (26.2.0) - Single-window, 2 monitors - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M1 (Apple7) - Apple M1 (8 threads) - 8.00 GiB memory ### Issue description I don't see anything related to this particular command mentioned in changelogs, so since this works fine in 4.5.1, I assume this is not what should happen in v4.6.rc2.official [78c6632eb]: ### Steps to reproduce Make a plugin and point it to this code: ``` @tool extends EditorPlugin const SCENE_PATH := "res://lab/Preview current scene.tscn" # change this to some scene var button: Button var run_button: Button var open_button: Button func _enter_tree(): var base = get_editor_interface().get_base_control() # Run button run_button = Button.new() run_button.icon = base.get_theme_icon("Play", "EditorIcons") run_button.tooltip_text = "Run Lab" run_button.pressed.connect(_run_scene) # Open button open_button = Button.new() open_button.icon = base.get_theme_icon("Load", "EditorIcons") open_button.tooltip_text = "Open Lab" open_button.pressed.connect(_open_scene) add_control_to_container(CONTAINER_TOOLBAR, run_button) add_control_to_container(CONTAINER_TOOLBAR, open_button) func _exit_tree(): remove_control_from_container(CONTAINER_TOOLBAR, run_button) remove_control_from_container(CONTAINER_TOOLBAR, open_button) run_button.queue_free() open_button.queue_free() func _run_scene(): get_editor_interface().play_custom_scene(SCENE_PATH) func _open_scene(): get_editor_interface().open_scene_from_path(SCENE_PATH) ``` ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) ( paste the code )
